correctness.rationale: Conditioning on rank(U) yields an exact Gaussian-binomial point-mass formula. Point mass strictly decreases with target rank; full-rank targets have likelihood ratio p_{k,r}<1, while the rank-(k-1) factor contribution alone makes every deficient-rank target more likely than uniform when k<=r<n. The entire TV deficit is therefore the full-rank set, giving p_{k,n}(1-p_{k,r}).

originality.rationale: The motivating paper proves only the upper bound 1-p_{k,r} and does not state the exact TV law or the iff rank-surplus threshold. Targeted searches of the motivating work, finite-field matrix-product/rank literature, masking terminology, and SCOPE records found no equivalent statement. Generic factorization counting may be folklore, so the novelty claim is restricted to the exact masking leakage identity and its security consequences.

value.rationale: The theorem turns an approximate individual-security guarantee into an exact formula and matching converse, proving that q^{k-r} is the true leakage scale and that vanishing leakage occurs exactly when r-k diverges for fixed q.
